###### 16.6.4.3.4.2	Test procedure

Same as the test procedure given in clause 6.6.4.2.4.2 with following exceptions:

-	Step 5 in test procedure given in clause 6.6.4.2.4.2 is replaced by following step.

5.	The UE shall start sending valid L1-RSRP reports. The SS shall check following requirements:

- R1:	the UE shall start to transmit valid reports no later than 720 ms for configurations 1, 2, 4 and no later than 680 ms for configuration 3 from the beginning of time period T2. A valid report shall meet the absolute L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#1 (Table 16.6.4.3.5-2 for test configurations 1, 2, 4 and Table 16.6.4.3.5-3 for test configuration 3) and the relative L1-RSRP requirement for SSB#0 in Table 16.6.4.3.5-4. If the first valid report is received earlier than the specified time, the number of passed iterations for R1 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failed iterations for R1 is increased by one.

- R2:	the UE shall transmit reports every 80 slots until the end of time period T2. If the reports are received accordingly, the number of passed iterations for R2 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failed iterations for R2 is increased by one.

- R3:	The L1-RSRP value of SSB#1 reported by the UE is compared to the expected L1-RSRP value for SSB#1. In all consecutive reports after the first valid value is received, if the resulting value is outside the limits in Table 16.6.4.3.5-2 for test configurations 1, 2, 4 and in Table 16.6.4.3.5-3 for test configuration 3 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#1, the number of failed iterations for R3 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R3 is increased by one.

-R4:	The DIFF RSRP value of SSB#0 reported by the UE is compared to the expected DIFF RSRP value. In all consecutive reports after the first valid value is received, if the resulting value is outside the limits in Table 16.6.4.3.5-4 or the UE fails to report the measurement value for SSB#0, the number of failed iterations for R4 is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of passed iterations for R4 is increased by one.

#### 16.6.5	NR measurements with autonomous gaps for RedCap

##### 16.6.5.0	Minimum conformance requirements

###### 16.6.5.0.1	Minimum conformance requirements for NR SA FR1 intra-frequency CGI identification of NR neighbour cell in FR1 for 1 Rx UE

The requirements in this clause are specified for CGI identification of an NR target cell and are applicable for a UE in RRC\_CONNECTED state and configured with SA operation mode.

The UE shall identify and report the CGI of a known NR target cell when requested by the network for the purpose of *reportCGI* . Only one cell is provided to the UE with *cellForWhichToReportCGI* for identifying the CGI. The UE may make autonomous gaps in both downlink reception and uplink transmission for receiving MIB and SIB1 message according to clause 5.5.3 of TS 38.331 [13]. Note that a UE is not required to use autonomous gap if *useAutonomousGaps* is set to false. If autonomous gaps are used for measurement with the purpose of *reportCGI* , regardless of whether DRX is used or not, the UE shall be able to identify a new CGI of NR cell within:

Tidentify\_CGI\_redcap = (TMIB\_redcap + T SIB1\_redcap) ms

Where:

TMIB\_redcap is the time period used to acquire MIB message. TMIB\_redcap = 6 * TSMTC ms for target cell carrier frequency on FR1.

TSIB1\_redcap is the time period used to acquire SIB1 message. TSIB1\_redcap = 12 * TRMSI-scheduling ms.

Where TSMTC is the SMTC periodicity configured for the target cell measurement, and TRMSI-scheduling is

-	the periodicity with which the SIB1 is actually transmitted by the NR target cell when SSB and RMSI CORESET multiplexing pattern is 1

-	the maximum between the periodicity with which the SIB1 is actually transmitted by the NR target cell and TSMTC when SSB and RMSI CORESET multiplexing pattern is 2 or 3.

The requirement for identifying the CGI of an NR cell within Tidentify\_CGI\_redcap is applicable when no DRX is used as well as when any of the DRX cycles specified in TS 38.331 [13] is used.

Within the time Tidentify\_CGI\_redcap, over which the UE identifies the CGI of an NR cell, the UE shall fulfil interruption requirements specified in,

-	Clause 9.11A.4 of TS 38.133 [6] if the UE is configured with SA operation mode.

In the requirement a cell is known if,

-	During the last 5 seconds before the reception of the report CGI command:

-	The UE has sent a valid L3-RSRP measurement report with SSB index for the target cell and

-	During MIB decoding at least reported SSBs remains detectable according to the cell identification conditions specified in clauses 9.2B or 9.3B of TS 38.133 [6], and

-	During SIB1 decoding the SSB used for MIB decoding remains detectable according to the cell identification conditions specified in clauses 9.2B or 9.3B of TS 38.133 [6], and

-	During MIB decoding, the SSB for MIB decoding remains detectable with SNR ≥ -3 dB

-	During SIB1 decoding, the PDSCH for SIB1 decoding remains detectable with SNR ≥ -3 dB

The CGI reporting delay is defined as the time between a command that will trigger a CGI report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty of 2 x TTIDCCH resulting when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes any delay caused by lack of UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

The CGI reporting delay shall be less than Tidentify\_CGI\_redcap plus RRC procedure delay defined in clause 12 in TS 38.331 [13].

When a RedCap UE is identifying CGI of an NR cell with autonomous gaps, the UE is not expected to transmit PUCCH/PUSCH/SRS or receive PDCCH/PDSCH/TRS/CSI-RS for CQI on PCell for the following slots:

-	with up to K1 interruptions with interrupted slots up to X1 specified in Table 16.6.5.0.1-1 for each interruption during MIB decoding time period TMIB\_redcap (ms).

-	with up to L1 interruptions with interrupted slots up to Y1 specified in Table 16.6.5.0.1-1 during SIB1 decoding time period TSIB1\_redcap (ms) for SSB and CORESET for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 1.

-	with up to L2 interruptions with interrupted slots up to interruption length Y2 specified in Table 16.6.5.0.1-1 during SIB1 decoding time period TSIB1\_redcap (ms) for SSB and CORESET for RMSI scheduling multiplexing patterns 2 and 3.

Where:

-	K1 = 6 for the target cell carrier frequency on FR1, and

-	L1 = TSIB1\_redcap /20 and

-	L2 = TSIB1\_redcap /TSMTC, where TSMTC is the periodicity of the SMTC occasion configured for the target cell carrier.

Table 16.6.5.0.1-1: Interruption length X1, Y1 and Y2 during measurements with autonomous gaps

|    |   NR Slot length (ms) of victim cell |   Interruption length X1 (slots) |   Interruption length Y1 (slots) |   Interruption length Y2 (slots) |
|----|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------|----------------------------------|----------------------------------|
|  0 |                                1     |                                6 |                                7 |                                6 |
|  1 |                                0.5   |                              12  |                               13 |                               10 |
|  2 |                                0.25  |                               24 |                               25 |                               19 |
|  3 |                                0.125 |                              48  |                               49 |                               37 |

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause 9.11A.

###### 16.6.5.0.2	Minimum conformance requirements for NR SA FR1 intra-frequency CGI identification of NR neighbour cell in FR1 for 2 Rx UE

Same as clause 16.6.5.0.1 with the following exception:

TSIB1\_redcap = 6 * TRMSI-scheduling ms

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause 9.11A.

###### 16.6.5.0.3	Minimum conformance requirements for CGI identification of an E-UTRA cell with autonomous gaps

The requirements in this clause apply when the 1 Rx RedCap UE or 2 Rx RedCap UE is configured with standalone NR. The UE shall identify and report the CGI when requested by an NR PCell for the purpose ‘ *reportCGI* ’. The UE may make autonomous gaps in downlink reception and uplink transmission for receiving MIB and SIB1 message according to clause 5.5.3.1 in TS 38.331 [13].

For 2 Rx RedCap UE: If autonomous gaps are used for measurement with the purpose of ‘reportCGI’, the UE shall be able to identify a new CGI of E-UTRA cell within $T_{identify \_ CGI \_ RedCap, E-UTRAN}$ = 150 ms.

For 1 Rx RedCap UE: If autonomous gaps are used for measurement with the purpose of ‘reportCGI’, the UE shall be able to identify a new CGI of E-UTRA cell within  $T_{identify \_ CGI \_ RedCap, E-UTRAN}$ = 190 ms.

This is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell, provided that the E-UTRA cell has been already identified by the UE.

A cell shall be considered identifiable following conditions are fulfilled:

-	RSRP related side conditions given in Clause 9.1 in TS 36.133 [23] are fulfilled for a corresponding band,

-	SCH\_RP and SCH Ês/Iot according to Annex B.2.2 in TS 36.133 [23] for a corresponding band

The MIB of an E-UTRA cell whose CGI is identified shall be considered decodable by the UE provided the PBCH demodulation requirements are met according to TS 36.101 [27].

The requirement for identifying a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell within  $T_{identify \_ CGI \_ RedCap, E-UTRAN}$ is applicable when no DRX is used as well as when any of the DRX cycles specified in TS 38.331 [13] is used.

The E-UTRA CGI reporting delay is defined as the time between a command that will trigger an E-UTRA CGI report and the point when the UE starts to transmit the measurement report over the air interface. This requirement assumes that the measurement report is not delayed by other RRC signalling on the DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes a delay uncertainty of 2 x TTIDCCH resulting when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH. This measurement reporting delay excludes any delay caused by lack of UL resources for UE to send the measurement report.

The CGI reporting delay shall be less than  $T_{identify \_ CGI \_ RedCap, E-UTRAN}$ plus RRC procedure delay defined in clause 12 in TS 38.331 [13], and an additional 30 ms margin.

When a UE is identifying CGI of an E-UTRA FDD cell or E-UTRA TDD cell with autonomous gaps, within time period Tidentify\_CGI\_RedCap, E-UTRA specified in this clause, the UE shall be able to transmit at least the number of ACK/NACKs specified in Table 16.6.5.0.3-1 on PCell in the frequency range where autonomous gaps are used, provided that:

-	there is continuous DL data allocation,

-	no DRX cycle is used,

-	no measurement gaps are configured,

-	only one code word is transmitted in each slot,

-	2 slot ACK/NACK feedback is configured,

-	20 ms SMTC period is configured.

Table 16.6.5.0.3-1: Minimum number of ACK/NACKs transmitted by the UE during Tidentify\_CGI\_RedCap, E-UTRAN

| Minimum number of transmitted ACK/NACKs   | SCS                       | SCS    |
|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------|--------|
|                                           | Duplex mode configuration | SCS    |
| 84                                        | FDD                       | 15 kHz |
| 193                                       | FDD                       | 30 kHz |
| 28                                        | TDD Note 1                | 15 kHz |
| 81                                        | TDD Note 1                | 30 kHz |
| NOTE 1:	TDD UL-DL configuration is as specified in Table A.3.3.1-1 of TS 38.101-1 [2].                                           | NOTE 1:	TDD UL-DL configuration is as specified in Table A.3.3.1-1 of TS 38.101-1 [2].                           | NOTE 1:	TDD UL-DL configuration is as specified in Table A.3.3.1-1 of TS 38.101-1 [2].        |

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clauses 9.4A.4.

###### 16.6.5.1.4.2	Test procedure

The test consists of two cells: Cell 1 and Cell 2. Cell 1 is the FR1 PCell and Cell 2 is an FR1 neighbour cell on the same frequency as the PCell. The general and cell specific test parameters for PCell and neighbour cell are given in Table 16.6.5.1.4.1-3 and Table 16.6.5.1.5-1, respectively. The test consists of three successive time periods, with time durations of T1, T2 and T3 respectively.

1. Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2. Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 16.6.5.1.5-1. T1 starts.

3. Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current Cell 2 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for one iteration of the test procedure loop.

4. The SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 16.6.5.1.5-1. T2 starts.

5. SS shall transmit an *RRCReconfiguration* message to configure the measurement object for the frequency of the serving cell and to indicate the UE that event-triggered reporting with Event A3 is used.

6. The UE shall transmit *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

7. UE shall transmit a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event A3.

8. After the SS receives the *MeasurementReport* message in step 6, the SS shall transmit *RRCReconfiguration* message triggering CGI identification and configuring *reportCGI* and *useAutonomousGaps* IEs set to TRUE.

9. T3 starts when the last TTI containing the above RRC message implying CGI identification is sent to the UE.

10. The UE shall transmit *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

11. The SS verifies that potential interruption is carried out correctly by monitoring ACK/NACK sent in PCell during T3 until a measurement report with CGI is sent. If the UE sends a measurement report containing the CGI of Cell 2 within 372 ms from the start of time period T3, then the number of successful tests is increased by one otherwise the number of failure tests is increased by one.

12. Repeat steps 2-11 until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

##### 16.6.5.2	NR SA FR1 CGI identification of NR neighbour cell for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.6.5.2.1	Test Purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the UE makes correct reporting of intra-frequency CGI identification of an NR neighbour cell in FR1 with autonomous gaps. This test shall partly verify the measurement requirements in clause 9.11A of TS 38.133 [6].

###### 16.6.5.2.2	Test Applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from release 17 onwards and supporting acquisition of CGI from neighbour NR cell using autonomous gap.

###### 16.6.5.2.3	Minimum Conformance Requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.6.5.0.2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.6.5.2.

The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

##### 16.6.5.3	NR SA FR1 - E-UTRA CGI Identification of E-UTRA cell for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.6.5.3.1	Test purpose

To verify the requirement for identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell with autonomous gaps in NR SA in TS 38.133 [6] clause 9.4A.4.

###### 16.6.5.3.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting acquisition of CGI from neighbour E-UTRA cell using autonomous gap.

###### 16.6.5.3.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.6.5.0.3.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.6.5.3.

###### 16.6.5.3.4	Test description

The test scenario comprises of one NR carrier and an E-UTRA carrier and two cells. PDCCHs indicating new transmissions shall be sent continuously to ensure that the UE would have ACK/NACK sending during identifying a new CGI of E-UTRAN cell.

The test consists of three successive time periods, with time durations of T1, T2 and T3 respectively:

-	At the start of time duration T1, the UE does not have any timing information of Cell 2.

-	Starting T2, Cell 2 becomes detectable and the UE is expected to detect and send a measurement report. A RRC message implying SI reading shall be sent to the UE during period T2, after the UE has reported Event B2. The RRC message shall create a measurement report configuration with purpose *reportCGI* and *useAutonomousGaps* set to *setup* .

-	The start of T3 is the instant when the last TTI containing the RRC message implying SI reading is sent to the UE.

###### 16.6.5.3.4.2	Test procedure

Throughout the test, the UE shall be scheduled to perform DL reception on every slot suitable for DL.

1.	Ensure the UE is in State RRC\_CONNECTED with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5. Establish SRB2 and DRB in the *RRCReconfiguration* message. Cell 1 is the active cell.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 16.6.5.3.5-1 and Table 16.6.5.3.5-2. T1 starts.

3.	The SS transmits an *RRCReconfiguration* message to configure event B2 triggered measurement reporting on E-UTRA Cell 2.

4.	The UE transmits an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

5.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Tables 16.6.5.3.5-1 and 16.6.5.3.5-2, T2 starts.

6.	UE transmits a *MeasurementReport* message triggered by Event B2.

7.	After receiving *MeasurementReport* message in step 6, the SS transmits an *RRCReconfiguration* message to release the gap configuration.

8.	UE transmits an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

9.	After receiving *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message in step 6, the SS transmits an *RRCReconfiguration* message to configure an autonomous gap based CGI measurement reporting on E-UTRA Cell 2.

10.	The start of T3 is the instant when the last TTI containing the *RRCReconfiguration* message in step 7 is sent to the UE, at that instant the SS shall switch the power setting from T2 to T3 as specified in Tables 16.6.5.3.5-1 and 16.6.5.3.5-2.

11.	The UE transmits an *RRCReconfigurationComplete* message.

12. If the UE

a)	transmits a *MeasurementReport* message containing CGI of E-UTRA Cell 2 less than 240 ms from the beginning of time period T3, and

b)	transmits ACK/NACKs no less than the minimum number of ACK/NACKs given in Table 16.6.5.3.5-5 from the start of T3 until 240 ms,

then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

13.	Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current Cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 14 + 2) for next iteration of the test procedure loop.

14.	Repeat steps 2-13 until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

The UE shall transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of Cell 2 within overall delay from the start of T3, where the overall delay is calculated as follows,

Overall delay = TRRC Processing + Tidentify\_CGI\_RedCap, E-UTRAN + additional margin + TTI insertion uncertainty

-	TRRC Processing = 15 ms;

-	Tidentify\_CGI\_RedCap, E-UTRAN = 190 ms, is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell;

-	TTI insertion uncertainty = 2 x TTIDCCH = 2 ms, is the delay uncertainty when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH;

-	additional margin = 30 ms, is specified in TS 38.133 [6] clause 9.4A.4.2

Which gives overall delay = 15 + 190 + 30 + 2 = 237 ms, allow 240 ms.

From the start of T3 until 240 ms. The number of ACK/NACK being transmitted by the UE shall be no less than the minimum number of ACK/NACK given in Table 16.6.5.3.5-5.

The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

Table 16.6.5.3.5-5: Minimum number of ACK/NACKs transmitted by the UE during the overall delay

| Test configuration   | Minimum number of transmitted ACK/NACKsNote 1   |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| 1, 4                 | 127                                             |
| 2, 5                 | 42                                              |
| 3, 6                 | 115                                             |
| NOTE 1:	The overall ACK/NACK number is caused by two parts. Firstly, at least X ACK/NACK shall be sent during identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2, where X is defined in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.4A.4.3-1. Secondly, given that continuous DL data allocation, additional 43, 14 and 34 ACK/NACK shall be sent for FDD 15 kHz, TDD 15 kHz and TDD 30 kHz, respectively, from the start of T3 until 240 ms excludes 190 ms for identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2.                      | NOTE 1:	The overall ACK/NACK number is caused by two parts. Firstly, at least X ACK/NACK shall be sent during identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2, where X is defined in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.4A.4.3-1. Secondly, given that continuous DL data allocation, additional 43, 14 and 34 ACK/NACK shall be sent for FDD 15 kHz, TDD 15 kHz and TDD 30 kHz, respectively, from the start of T3 until 240 ms excludes 190 ms for identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2.                                                 |

##### 16.6.5.4	NR SA FR1 - E-UTRA CGI Identification of E-UTRA cell for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.6.5.4.1	Test purpose

To verify the requirement for identification of a new CGI of E-UTRA cell with autonomous gaps in NR SA in TS 38.133 [6] clause 9.4A.4.

###### 16.6.5.4.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting acquisition of CGI from neighbour E-UTRA cell using autonomous gap.

###### 16.6.5.4.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.6.5.0.3.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.6.5.4.

###### 16.6.5.4.4	Test description

Same as the test description given in clause 16.6.5.3.4

###### 16.6.5.4.4.2	Test procedure

Same as the test procedure given in clause 16.6.5.3.4.2 with following exceptions:

-	Step 12 in clause 16.6.5.3.4.2 is replaced by following step:

12.	If the UE

a)	transmits a *MeasurementReport* message containing CGI of E-UTRA Cell 2 less than 200 ms from the beginning of time period T3, and

b)	transmits ACK/NACKs no less than the minimum number of ACK/NACKs given in Table 16.6.5.4.5-5 from the start of T3 until 200 ms,

then the number of successful tests is increased by one. Otherwise, the number of failure tests is increased by one.

The UE shall transmit a measurement report containing the cell global identifier of Cell 2 within overall delay from the start of T3, where the overall delay is calculated as follows,

Overall delay = TRRC Processing + Tidentify\_CGI\_RedCap, E-UTRAN + additional margin + TTI insertion uncertainty

-	TRRC Processing = 15 ms;

-	Tidentify\_CGI\_RedCap, E-UTRAN = 150 ms, is the maximum allowed time for the UE to identify a new CGI of an E-UTRA cell;

-	TTI insertion uncertainty = 2 x TTIDCCH = 2 ms, is the delay uncertainty when inserting the measurement report to the TTI of the uplink DCCH;

-	additional margin = 30 ms, is specified in TS 38.133 [6] clause 9.4A.4.2

Which gives overall delay = 15 + 150 + 30 + 2 = 197 ms, allow 200 ms.

From the start of T3 until 200 ms. The number of ACK/NACK being transmitted by the UE shall be no less than the minimum number of ACK/NACK given in Table 16.6.5.4.5-5.

The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

Table 16.6.5.4.5-5: Minimum number of ACK/NACKs transmitted by the UE during the overall delay

| Test configuration   | Minimum number of transmitted ACK/NACKsNote 1   |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| 1, 4                 | 127                                             |
| 2, 5                 | 42                                              |
| 3, 6                 | 115                                             |
| NOTE 1:	The overall ACK/NACK number is caused by two parts. Firstly, at least X ACK/NACK shall be sent during identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2, where X is defined in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.4A.4.3-1. Secondly, given that continuous DL data allocation, additional 43, 14 and 34 ACK/NACK shall be sent for FDD 15 kHz, TDD 15 kHz and TDD 30 kHz, respectively, from the start of T3 until 200 ms excludes 150 ms for identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2.                      | NOTE 1:	The overall ACK/NACK number is caused by two parts. Firstly, at least X ACK/NACK shall be sent during identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2, where X is defined in TS 38.133 [6] Table 9.4A.4.3-1. Secondly, given that continuous DL data allocation, additional 43, 14 and 34 ACK/NACK shall be sent for FDD 15 kHz, TDD 15 kHz and TDD 30 kHz, respectively, from the start of T3 until 200 ms excludes 150 ms for identifying the cell global identifier of Cell 2.                                                 |

The reporting range for SS-RSRP is defined from -156 dBm to -31 dBm with 1 dB resolution. The mapping of the measured quantity to the reported value is defined by Table 4.7.1.0.1-2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clauses 10.1A.4.1.1 and 10.1.6.

###### 16.7.1.0.4	Inter-frequency relative SS-RSRP measurement accuracy requirements

The accuracy requirements in clause 6.7.1.0.4 shall apply when RedCap UE is capable of 2 Rx. When UE is only required to support 1 Rx, the absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.0.4-1 are valid under the following conditions:

-	Conditions defined in clause 7.3 of TS 38.101-1 [2] for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

-	Conditions for inter-frequency measurements are fulfilled according to Annex B.2.3 for a corresponding band for each relevant SSB.

-	|SSB\_RP1dBm - SSB\_RP2dBm| ≤ 27 dB

-	|Channel 1\_Io -Channel 2\_Io |  20 dB

##### 16.7.1.1	Intra-frequency measurements for RedCap for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.1.1.1	NR SA FR1 SS-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.1.1.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the intra-frequency SS-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

###### 16.7.1.1.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.1.1.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.1.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.1.1.

###### 16.7.1.1.1.4	Test description

###### 16.7.1.1.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 16.7.1.1.1.4.1-1.

Table 16.7.1.1.1.4.1-1: NR SA FR1 SS-RSRP measurement accuracy supported test configurations

| Test Case ID                                                                            | Description                                                                             |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 16.7.1.1.1-1                                                                            | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, FDD duplex mode                                    |
| 16.7.1.1.1-2                                                                            | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode                                    |
| 16.7.1.1.1-3                                                                            | NR 30 kHz SSB SCS, 20 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode                                    |
| 16.7.1.1.1-4                                                                            | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, HD-FDD duplex mode                                 |
| Note: The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations. | Note: The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations. |

2. Cell 1 is the NR FR1 serving cell (PCell) and Cell 2 is the NR neighbour in the same frequency and the target cell for SS-RSRP measurements. The connection setup is done according to the settings in Annex C.1.1 and C.1.2.

###### 16.7.1.1.1.4.2	Test procedure

Same as the test procedure given in clause 6.7.1.1.1.4.2 with following exceptions:

-	Table 6.7.1.1.1.5-1 is replaced by Table 16.7.1.1.1.5-1.

-	Table 6.7.1.1.1.5-2 is replaced by Table 16.7.1.1.1.5-2.

###### 16.7.1.1.1.4.3	Message contents

Same as the message contents given in clause 6.7.1.1.1.4.3 with following exceptions:

-	Specific message contents exceptions for test configuration 6.7.1.1.1-1 applies to test configuration 16.7.1.1.1-4.

-	Table H.3.1-3 is used with associated condition SSB.1 RedCap FR1 for test configuration 16.7.1.1.1-3

###### 16.7.1.1.1.5	Test requirement

Table 16.7.1.1.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests.

Each SS-RSRP measurement report for each of the tests in Table 16.7.1.1.1.5-1 shall meet the corresponding absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.1.1.5-2 for test configurations 1, 2 and 4 and the corresponding absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.1.1.5-3 for test configuration 3.

###### 16.7.1.1.2	NR SA FR1 SS-RSRP relative measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.1.1.2.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the intra-frequency SS-RSRP relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

###### 16.7.1.1.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.1.0.2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.1.1.

###### 16.7.1.2.1.4.3	Message contents

Same as the message contents given in clause 6.7.1.1.1.4.3 with following exceptions:

-	Specific message contents exceptions for test configuration 6.7.1.1.1-1 applies to test configuration 16.7.1.2.1-4.

###### 16.7.1.2.1.5	Test requirement

Table 16.7.1.2.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests.

Each SS-RSRP measurement report for each of the tests in Table 16.7.1.2.1.5-1 shall meet the corresponding absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.2.1.5-2 for test configurations 1, 2 and 4 and the corresponding absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.2.1.5-3 for test configuration 3.

###### 16.7.1.3.2	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-RSRP relative measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.1.3.2.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the inter-frequency SS-RSRP relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

###### 16.7.1.3.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.1.3.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.1.0.4.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.1.3.

###### 16.7.1.3.2.4	Test description

###### 16.7.1.3.2.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 16.7.1.3.2.4.1-1.

| Test Case ID                                                                            | Description                                                                             |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| 16.7.1.3.2-1                                                                            | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, FDD duplex mode                                    |
| 16.7.1.3.2-2                                                                            | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode                                    |
| 16.7.1.3.2-3                                                                            | NR 30 kHz SSB SCS, 20 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode                                    |
| 16.7.1.3.2-4                                                                            | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, HD-FDD duplex mode                                 |
| Note: The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations. | Note: The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations. |

Table 16.7.1.4.1.5-1 defines the primary level settings including test tolerances for all tests.

Each SS-RSRP measurement report for each of the tests in Table 16.7.1.4.1.5-1 shall meet the corresponding absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.4.1.5-2 for test configurations 1, 2 and 4 and the corresponding absolute accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.1.4.1.5-3 for test configuration 3.

##### 16.7.2.2	NR SA FR1 SS-RSRQ absolute measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.2.2.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify that the intra-frequency SS-RSRQ absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

###### 16.7.2.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.2.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.2.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.2.2.

###### 16.7.2.2.4	Test description

###### 16.7.2.2.4.1	Initial conditions

-	Table 6.7.2.1.4.1-1 is replaced by Table 16.7.2.2.4.1-1;

-	Table 6.7.2.1.4.1-2 is replaced by Table 16.7.2.2.4.1-2.

##### 16.7.2.3	Inter-frequency measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.2.3.1	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-RSRQ absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.2.3.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the inter-frequency SS-RSRQ absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.8.1.1.

###### 16.7.2.3.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.2.3.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.2.0.2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.2.3.

###### 16.7.2.3.1.4	Test description

###### 16.7.2.3.1.4.1	Initial conditions

Same as the initial conditions given in clause 6.7.2.2.1 with followings exceptions:

-	Table 6.7.2.2.1.4.1-1 is replaced by Table 16.7.2.3.1.4.1-1;

-	Table 6.7.2.2.1.4.1-2 is replaced by Table 16.7.2.3.1.4.1-2.

| 16.7.2.3.1-2 | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode    |

| 16.7.2.3.1-4 | NR 15 kHz SSB SCS, 10 MHz bandwidth, HD-FDD duplex mode |

###### 16.7.2.3.2	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-RSRQ relative measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.2.3.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the inter-frequency SS-RSRQ relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.8.1.2.

###### 16.7.2.3.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.2.3.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.2.0.3.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.2.3.

###### 16.7.2.4.2	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-RSRQ relative measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.2.4.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the inter-frequency SS-RSRQ relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.8.1.2.

###### 16.7.2.4.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.2.4.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.2.0.3.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.2.4.

##### 16.7.3.1	NR SA FR1 SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the intra-frequency SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.10.1.1.

###### 16.7.3.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting SS-SINR measurement.

###### 16.7.3.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.3.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.3.1.

##### 16.7.3.2	NR SA FR1 SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the intra-frequency SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.10.1.1.

###### 16.7.3.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting SS-SINR measurement.

###### 16.7.3.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.3.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.3.2.

###### 16.7.3.2.4	Test description

##### 16.7.3.3	Inter-frequency measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.3.1	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.3.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the inter-frequency SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.12.1.1.

###### 16.7.3.3.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting SS-SINR measurement.

###### 16.7.3.3.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.3.0.2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.3.3.

##### 16.7.3.4	Inter-frequency measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.4.1	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.4.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the inter-frequency SS-SINR absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.12.1.1.

###### 16.7.3.4.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting SS-SINR measurement.

###### 16.7.3.4.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.3.0.2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.3.4.

###### 16.7.3.4.2	NR SA FR1-FR1 SS-SINR relative measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.3.4.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the inter-frequency SS-SINR relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.1A.12.1.2.

###### 16.7.3.4.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting SS-SINR measurement.

###### 16.7.3.4.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

##### 16.7.4.1	SSB based L1-RSRP measurements for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.4.1.1	NR SA FR1 SSB based L1-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.4.1.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the SSB based L1-RSRP absolute measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

###### 16.7.4.1.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

###### 16.7.4.3.2	NR SA FR1 CSI-RS based L1-RSRP relative measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.4.3.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the CSI-RS based L1-RSRP relative measurement accuracy is within the specified limits for all bands.

###### 16.7.4.3.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards.

#### 16.7.5	E-UTRAN RSRP for RedCap

##### 16.7.5.0	Minimum conformance requirements

###### 16.7.5.0.1	E-UTRAN RSRP absolute accuracy

When RedCap UE is capable of 2 Rx, the minimum requirements given in clause 6.7.5.0.1 shall apply.

When RedCap UE is only required to support 1 Rx, the requirements for absolute accuracy of RSRP in this clause apply to a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell.

The accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.5.0.1-1 are valid under the following conditions:

Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports.

Conditions defined in TS 36.101 [27] Clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

RSRP|dBm according to TS 36.133 [23] Annex B.3.3 for a corresponding band.

##### 16.7.5.1	NR SA FR1 - E-UTRA RSRP absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.5.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the E-UTRAN RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.2A.2 for SA inter-RAT E-UTRAN RSRP measurements.

###### 16.7.5.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting E-UTRA.

###### 16.7.5.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.5.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.5.1.

##### 16.7.5.2	NR SA FR1 - E-UTRA RSRP absolute measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.5.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the E-UTRAN RSRP measurement accuracy is within the specified limits. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.2A.2 for SA inter-RAT E-UTRAN RSRP measurements.

###### 16.7.5.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting E-UTRA.

###### 16.7.5.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.5.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.5.2.

###### 16.7.5.2.4	Test description

###### 16.7.5.2.4.1	Initial conditions

#### 16.7.6	E-UTRAN RSRQ for RedCap

##### 16.7.6.0	Minimum conformance requirements

###### 16.7.6.0.1	E-UTRAN RSRQ absolute accuracy

When RedCap UE is capable of 2 Rx, the minimum requirements given in clause 6.7.6.0.1 shall apply.

When RedCap UE is only required to support 1 Rx, the requirements for absolute accuracy of RSRQ in this clause apply to a cell that has different carrier frequency from the serving cell.

The accuracy requirements in Table 16.7.6.0.1-1 are valid under the following conditions:

Cell specific reference signals are transmitted either from one, two or four antenna ports.

Conditions defined in TS 36.101 [27] Clause 7.3 for reference sensitivity are fulfilled.

RSRP|dBm according to TS 36.133 [23] Annex B.3.1 for a corresponding band.

##### 16.7.6.1	NR SA FR1 - E-UTRA RSRQ absolute measurement accuracy for 1 Rx UE

###### 16.7.6.1.1	Test purpose

To verify that the E-UTRAN RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limits. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.2A.2 for SA inter-RAT E-UTRAN RSRP measurements.

###### 16.7.6.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs with 1 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting E-UTRA.

###### 16.7.6.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.6.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.6.1.

##### 16.7.6.2	NR SA FR1 - E-UTRA RSRQ absolute measurement accuracy for 2 Rx UE

###### 16.7.6.2.1	Test purpose

To verify that the E-UTRAN RSRQ measurement accuracy is within the specified limits. This test will verify the requirements in TS 38.133 [6] clause 10.2A.2 for SA inter-RAT E-UTRAN RSRP measurements.

###### 16.7.6.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UEs with 2 Rx from Release 17 onwards and supporting E-UTRA.

###### 16.7.6.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are specified in clause 16.7.6.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.16.7.6.2.

## 17	NR standalone tests in FR2 for RedCap

### 17.1	RRC\_IDLE state mobility for RedCap

#### 17.1.1	NR cell re-selection for RedCap

##### 17.1.1.0	Minimum conformance requirements

###### 17.1.1.0.1	Minimum conformance requirements for intra-frequency cell re-selection for RedCap

The UE shall be able to identify new intra-frequency cells and perform SS-RSRP and SS-RSRQ measurements of the identified intra-frequency cells without an explicit intra-frequency neighbour list containing physical layer cell identities.

The UE shall be able to evaluate whether a newly detectable intra-frequency cell meets the re-selection criteria defined in TS 38.304 [30] within Tdetect,NR\_Intra\_RedCap when that Treselection = 0. An intra-frequency cell is considered to be detectable according to the conditions defined in TS 38.133 [6] Annex B.1.4 for a corresponding band.

The UE shall measure SS-RSRP and SS-RSRQ at least every Tmeasure,NR\_Intra\_RedCap for intra-frequency cells that are identified and measured according to the measurement rules.

The UE shall filter SS-RSRP and SS-RSRQ measurements of each measured intra-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements. Within the set of measurements used for the filtering, at least two measurements shall be spaced by at least Tmeasure,NR\_Intra\_RedCap/2.

The UE shall not consider a NR neighbour cell in cell re-selection, if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

For an intra-frequency cell that has been already detected, but that has not been reselected to, the filtering shall be such that the UE shall be capable of evaluating that the intra-frequency cell has met re-selection criterion defined in TS 38.304 [30] within Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap when Treselection = 0 provided that:

when *rangeToBestCell* is not configured:

-	the cell is at least 4.5 dB better ranked in FR2 for 2 Rx RedCap.

when *rangeToBestCell* is configured:

-	the cell has the highest number of beams above the threshold *absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation* among all detected cells whose cell-ranking criterion R value in TS 38.304 [30] is within *rangeToBestCell* of the cell-ranking criterion R value of the highest ranked cell.

-	if there are multiple such cells, the cell has the highest rank among them.

-	the cell is at least 4.5 dB better ranked in FR2 if the current serving cell is among them for 2 Rx RedCap.

When evaluating cells for re selection, the SSB side conditions apply to both serving and non-serving intra-frequency cells.

If Treselection timer has a non-zero value and the intra-frequency cell is satisfied with the re-selection criteria which are defined in TS 38.304 [30], the UE shall evaluate this intra-frequency cell for the Treselection time. If this cell remains satisfied with the re-selection criteria within this duration, then the UE shall reselect that cell.

For 2 Rx RedCap not configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle, Tdetect,NR\_Intra\_RedCap, Tmeasure,NR\_Intra\_RedCap and Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap are specified in Table 17.1.1.0.1-1.

For 2 Rx RedCap configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle, Tdetect,NR\_Intra\_RedCap, Tmeasure,NR\_Intra\_RedCap and Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap are specified in Table 17.1.1.0.1-2 for FR2, where the requirements apply provided that the serving cell is configured with eDRX\_IDLE and is the same in all PTWs during any of Tdetect,NR\_Intra\_RedCap, Tmeasure,NR\_Intra\_RedCap and Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap when multiple PTWs are used.

For any requirement in this section, when the UE transitions between any two states when being configured with eDRX\_IDLE, being configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle, changing eDRX\_IDLE cycle length, or changing PTW configuration, the UE shall meet the transition requirement, which is the less stringent requirement of the two requirements corresponding to the first state and the second state, during the transition time interval which is the time corresponding to the transition requirement. After the transition time interval, the UE shall meet the requirement corresponding to the second state.

###### 17.1.1.0.2	Minimum conformance requirements for inter-frequency cell re-selection for RedCap

The UE shall be able to identify new inter-frequency cells and perform SS-RSRP or SS-RSRQ measurements of identified inter-frequency cells if carrier frequency information is provided by the serving cell, even if no explicit neighbour list with physical layer cell identities is provided.

If Srxlev &gt; SnonIntraSearchP and Squal &gt; SnonIntraSearchQ then the UE shall search for inter-frequency layers of higher priority at least every Thigher\_priority\_search where Thigher\_priority\_search is described in TS 38.133 [6] in clause 4.2.2.7.

If Srxlev ≤ SnonIntraSearchP or Squal ≤ SnonIntraSearchQ then the UE shall search for and measure inter-frequency layers of higher, equal or lower priority in preparation for possible re-selection. In this scenario, the minimum rate at which the UE is required to search for and measure higher priority layers shall be the same as that defined below in this clause.

The UE shall be able to evaluate whether a newly detectable inter-frequency cell meets the re-selection criteria defined in TS 38.304 [30] within Kcarrier\_RedCap * Tdetect,NR\_Inter\_RedCap if at least carrier frequency information is provided for inter-frequency neighbour cells by the serving cells when Treselection = 0 provided that the re-selection criteria is met

For 2 Rx RedCap by a margin of at least

5 dB in FR1 or 6.5 dB in FR2 for re-selections based on ranking or

7.5 dB in FR2 for SS-RSRP re-selections based on absolute priorities or

4 dB in FR2 for SS-RSRQ re-selections based on absolute priorities

The parameter Kcarrier\_RedCap is the number of NR inter-frequency carriers indicated by the serving cell. An inter-frequency cell is considered to be detectable according to the conditions defined in TS 38.133 [6] in Annex B.1.5 for a corresponding band. When higher priority cells are found by the higher priority search, they shall be measured at least every Tmeasure,NR\_Inter\_RedCap. If, after detecting a cell in a higher priority search, it is determined that re-selection has not occurred then the UE is not required to continuously measure the detected cell to evaluate the ongoing possibility of re-selection. However, the minimum measurement filtering requirements specified later in this clause shall still be met by the UE before it makes any determination that it may stop measuring the cell. If the UE detects on a NR carrier a cell whose physical identity is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell, the UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

The UE shall measure SS-RSRP or SS-RSRQ at least every Kcarrier\_RedCap * Tmeasure,NR\_Inter\_RedCap for identified lower or equal priority inter-frequency cells. If the UE detects on a NR carrier a cell whose physical identity is indicated as not allowed for that carrier in the measurement control system information of the serving cell, the UE is not required to perform measurements on that cell.

The UE shall filter SS-RSRP or SS-RSRQ measurements of each measured higher, lower and equal priority inter-frequency cell using at least 2 measurements. Within the set of measurements used for the filtering, at least two measurements shall be spaced by at least Tmeasure,NR\_Inter/2.

The UE shall not consider a NR neighbour cell in cell re-selection, if it is indicated as not allowed in the measurement control system information of the serving cell.

For an inter-frequency cell that has been already detected, but that has not been reselected to, the filtering shall be such that the UE shall be capable of evaluating that the inter-frequency cell has met re-selection criterion defined TS 38.304 [30] within Kcarrier * Tevaluate,NR\_Inter\_RedCap when Treselection = 0 provided that the re-selection criteria is met by

-	the condition when performing equal priority re-selection and

-	when *rangeToBestCell* is not configured:

-	the cell is at least 6.5 dB better ranked in FR2 for 2 Rx RedCap.

-	when *rangeToBestCell* is configured:

-	the cell has the highest number of beams above the threshold *absThreshSS-BlocksConsolidation* among all detected cells whose cell-ranking criterion R value defined in TS 38.304 [30] is within *rangeToBestCell* of the cell-ranking criterion R value of the highest ranked cell.

-	if there are multiple such cells, the cell has the highest rank among them

-	the cell is at least 6.5 dB better ranked in FR2 if the current serving cell is among them, or 7.5 dB in FR2 for SS-RSRP re-selections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap or 4 dB in FR2 for SS-RSRQ re-selections based on absolute priorities for 2 Rx RedCap.

When evaluating cells for re-selection, the SSB side conditions apply to both serving and inter-frequency cells.

If Treselection timer has a non-zero value and the inter-frequency cell is satisfied with the re-selection criteria, the UE shall evaluate this inter-frequency cell for the Treselection time. If this cell remains satisfied with the re-selection criteria within this duration, then the UE shall reselect that cell.

The UE is not expected to meet the measurement requirements for an inter-frequency carrier under DRX cycle = 320 ms defined in TS 38.133 [6] in Table 17.1.1.0.2-1 for 2 Rx RedCap under the following conditions:

-	TSMTC\_intra = TSMTC\_inter = 160 ms; where TSMTC\_intra and TSMTC\_inter are periodicities of the SMTC occasions configured for the intra-frequency carrier and the inter-frequency carrier respectively, and

-	SMTC occasions configured for the inter-frequency carrier occur up to 1 ms before the start or up to 1 ms after the end of the SMTC occasions configured for the intra-frequency carrier, and

-	SMTC occasions configured for the intra-frequency carrier and for the inter-frequency carrier occur up to 1 ms before the start or up to 1 ms after the end of the paging occasion defined in TS 38.304 [30].

For Rx RedCap not configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle, Tdetect,NR\_Inter\_RedCap, Tmeasure,NR\_Inter\_RedCap and Tevaluate,NR\_Inter\_RedCap are specified in Table 17.1.1.0.2-1.

For 2 Rx RedCap configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle, Tdetect,NR\_Inter\_RedCap, Tmeasure,NR\_Inter\_RedCap and Tevaluate,NR\_Inter\_RedCap are specified in Table 17.1.1.0.2-2 for FR2. The requirements apply provided that the serving cell is configured with eDRX\_IDLE and is the same in all PTWs during any of Tdetect,NR\_Inter\_RedCap, Tmeasure,NR\_Inter\_RedCap and Tevaluate,NR\_Inter\_RedCap when multiple PTWs are used.

###### 17.1.1.0.3	Minimum conformance requirements for intra-frequency cell re-selection for RedCap UE configured with stationary relaxed measurement criterion

This clause contains requirements for measurements on intra-frequency NR cells provided that:

-	UE is configured with *stationaryMobilityEvaluation* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion and UE has fulfilled that criterion, or

-	UE is configured with both *stationaryMobilityEvaluation* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion and *cellEdgeEvaluationWhileStationary* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion and *combineRelaxedMeasCondition2* defined in TS 38.331 [13] not configured, and UE has fulfilled only the *stationaryMobilityEvaluation* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion

The requirements defined in clause 17.1.1.0.3 apply for this clause except that:

-	Tdetect,NR\_Intra\_RedCap\_Relax as specified in Table 17.1.1.0.3-1 for 2 Rx RedCap.

-	Tmeasure,NR\_Intra\_RedCap\_Relax as specified in Table 17.1.1.0.3-1 for 2 Rx RedCap.

-	Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap\_Relax as specified in Table 17.1.1.0.3-1 for 2 Rx RedCap.

If the UE is configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle then the requirements in Table 17.1.1.0.3-2 are applicable for eDRX cycle up to 10.24 s in FR2.

If the UE is configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle greater than 10.24 s in FR2, then the requirements in Table 17.1.1.0.3-3 apply provided eDRX cycle is ≤ 163.84 sec and evaluation/measurement time with relaxation on one carrier is not greater than single PTW window length.

###### 17.1.1.0.4	Minimum conformance requirements for inter-frequency cell re-selection for RedCap UE configured with stationary relaxed measurement criterion

This clause contains requirements for measurements on inter-frequency NR cells provided that:

-	UE is configured with *stationaryMobilityEvaluation* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion and UE has fulfilled that criterion, or

-	UE is configured with both *stationaryMobilityEvaluation* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion and *cellEdgeEvaluationWhileStationary* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion and *combineRelaxedMeasCondition2* defined in TS 38.331 [13] not configured, and UE has fulfilled only the *stationaryMobilityEvaluation* defined in TS 38.331 [13] criterion, and

The requirements defined in clause17.1.1.0.4 apply for this clause except that:

-	Tdetect,NR\_Inter\_RedCap\_Relax as specified in Table 17.1.1.0.4-1 for 2 Rx RedCap.

-	Tmeasure,NR\_Inter\_RedCap\_Relax as specified in Table 17.1.1.0.4-1 for 2 Rx RedCap.

-	Tevaluate,NR\_Inter\_RedCap\_Relax as specified in Table 17.1.1.0.4-1 and for 2 Rx RedCap.

-	When Srxlev &gt; SnonIntraSearchP and Squal &gt; SnonIntraSearchQ then the UE shall search for inter-frequency layers of higher priority at least every K2*Thigher\_priority\_search where Thigher\_priority\_search is described in TS 38.133 [6] in clause 4.2.2.7 and, K2 = 240.

If the UE is configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle then the requirements in Table 17.1.1.0.4-2 are applicable for eDRX cycle up to 10.24 s in FR2.

If the UE is configured with eDRX\_IDLE cycle greater than 10.24 s FR2, then the requirements in Table 17.1.1.0.4-3 apply provided that eDRX cycle is ≤ 163.84 sec and evaluation/measurement time with relaxation on one carrier is not greater than single PTW window length.

##### 17.1.1.1	NR SA FR2 Cell reselection for 2 Rx UE

Editor’s Note: This test case is complete for the following configurations:

Test frequency f ≤ 40.8 GHz.

UE PC3

This test case is incomplete for Test frequency f &gt; 40.8 GHz

This test case is incomplete for UE power class other than PC3.

###### 17.1.1.1.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify the requirement for the NR SA intra-frequency cell reselection in FR2 for 2 Rx RedCap UEs. The requirements are specified in TS 38.133 [6] in clause 4.2B.2.3.

###### 17.1.1.1.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE release 17 and forward.

###### 17.1.1.1.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 17.1.1.0.1.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.17.1.1.1.

###### 17.1.1.1.4	Test description

###### 17.1.1.1.4.1	Initial conditions

This test shall be tested using any of the test configurations in Table 17.1.1.1.4.1-1.

| 17.1.1.1-2      | 240 kHz SSB SCS, 100 MHz bandwidth, TDD duplex mode |
| Note:	The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations.                 | Note:	The UE is only required to be tested in one of the supported test configurations.                                                     |

1.	The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 17.1.1.1.4.1-3.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 17.1.1.1.4.3.

3.	The test scenario comprises of 1 NR carrier and 2 cells. Cell 1 and Cell 2 belong to different tracking areas. Furthermore, UE has not registered with network for the tracking area containing Cell 2.

Table 17.1.1.1.4.1-3: General test parameters for NR SA FR2 Cell reselection to FR2 intra-frequency NR case for 2 Rx

###### 17.1.1.1.4.2	Test procedure

Two cells are deployed in the test, which are one FR2 NR PCell (Cell 1) and an NR neighbour cell (Cell 2) on the same frequency. The test consists of 3 successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Only Cell 1 is already identified by the UE prior to the start of the test. Cell 1 and Cell 2 belong to different tracking areas. Furthermore, UE has not registered with network for the tracking area containing Cell 2.

In the following test procedure “UE responds” means “UE starts transmitting preamble on PRACH for sending the *RRCSETUPREQUEST* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE with generic procedure parameters connectivity *NR* , connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5 on Cell 1. Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = initial Cell 2 physical cell identity.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 17.1.1.1.5-1. T1 starts.

3.	Set Cell 2 physical cell identity = ((current Cell 2 physical cell identity + 3) mod 1008) for one iteration of the test procedure loop.

4.	When T1 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 17.1.1.1.5-1.

5.	The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection to a newly detectable cell, Cell 2.

6.	If the UE responds on the newly detectable cell, Cell 2 during time duration T2 within 130 seconds from the beginning of time period T2, then count a success for the event “Re-select newly detected Cell 2”. Otherwise, count a failure for the event “Re-select newly detected Cell 2”.

7.	If the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T2, after the re-selection or when T2 expires, continue with step 8.
Otherwise, if T2 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 2, the TE shall switch off and on the UE and skip to step 14.

8.	The SS shall send an *RRCRelease* message to ensure that the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE on Cell 2.

9.	The SS shall switch the power setting from T2 to T3 as specified in Table 17.1.1.1.5-1.

10.	The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection to an already detected cell, Cell 1.

11.	If the UE responds on the already detected cell, Cell 1 during time duration T3 within 27 seconds from the beginning of time period T3, then count a success for the event “Re-select already detected Cell 1”. Otherwise, count a fail for the event “Re-select already detected Cell 1”.

12.	If the UE has re-selected Cell 1 within T3, after the re-selection or when T3 expires, continues with step 13.
Otherwise, if T3 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 1, the TE shall switch off and on the UE and skip to step 14.

13.The SS shall send an *RRCRelease* message to ensure that the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE on Cell 1.

14.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE with generic procedure parameters connectivity *NR* , connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5 on Cell 1.

15.	Repeat steps 2-14 until a test verdict has been achieved.
Each of the events “Re-select newly detected Cell 2” and “Re-select already detected Cell 1” is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict.
If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

The cell re-selection delay to a newly detectable cell is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T2, to the moment when the UE camps on Cell 2 and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the *RRCSetupRequest* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility on Cell 2.

The cell re-selection delay to a newly detectable cell shall be less than 130 s.

The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T3, to the moment when the UE camps on Cell 1 and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the *RRCSetupRequest* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility on Cell 1.

The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell shall be less than 27 s.

NOTE:	The cell reselection delay to a newly detectable cell can be expressed as: Tdetect, NR\_Intra + TSI-NR, and to an already detected cell can be expressed as: Tevaluate, NR\_intra + TSI-NR,

The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with the confidence level of 95%.

##### 17.1.1.2	NR SA FR2-FR2 Cell reselection for 2 Rx UE

Editor’s Note: This test case is complete for the following configurations:

Test frequency f ≤ 40.8 GHz.

UE PC3

This test case is incomplete for Test frequency f &gt; 40.8 GHz

This test case is incomplete for UE power class other than PC3.

###### 17.1.1.2.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify the requirement for the NR SA inter-frequency cell reselection in FR2 for 2 Rx RedCap UEs. The requirements are specified in TS 38.133 [6] in clause 4.2B.2.4.

###### 17.1.1.2.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE release 17 and forward.

###### 17.1.1.2.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 17.1.1.0.2.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.17.1.1.2.

###### 17.1.1.2.4	Test description

###### 17.1.1.2.4.1	Initial conditions

1.	The general test parameter settings are set up according to Table 17.1.1.2.4.1-3.

2.	Message contents are defined in clause 17.1.1.2.4.3.

3.	The test scenario comprises of 2 cells on 2 different NR carriers. Both Cell 1 and Cell 2 are already identified by the UE prior to the start of the test. Cell 1 and Cell 2 belong to different tracking areas and Cell 2 is of higher priority than Cell 1. Furthermore, UE has not registered with network for the tracking area containing Cell 2.

Table 17.1.1.2.4.1-3: General test parameters for NR SA FR2-FR2 Cell reselection to FR2 inter-frequency NR for 2 Rx

###### 17.1.1.2.4.2	Test procedure

Two cells on two RF channels are deployed in the test, which are one FR2 NR PCell (Cell 2) on RF channel 1 and an NR neighbour cell (Cell 1) on RF channel 2. The test consists of 3 successive time periods, with time duration of T1, T2 and T3 respectively. Only Cell 2 is already identified by the UE prior to the start of the test. Cell 1 and Cell 2 belong to different tracking areas. Furthermore, UE has not registered with network for the tracking area containing Cell 2.

In the following test procedure “UE responds” means “UE starts transmitting preamble on PRACH for sending the *RRCSETUPREQUEST* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE with generic procedure parameters connectivity *NR* , connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5 on Cell 2. Set Cell 1 physical cell identity = initial Cell 1 physical cell identity.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 17.1.1.2.5-1. T1 starts.

3.	The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on the lower priority cell, Cell 1.

4.	If the UE responds on lower priority cell, Cell 1 during time duration T1 within 27 seconds from the beginning of time period T1, then count a success for the event “Re-select lower priority Cell 1”. Otherwise, count a fail for the event “Re-select lower priority Cell 1”.

5.	If the UE has re-selected Cell 1 within T1, after the re-selection or when T1 expires, continue with step 6.
Otherwise, if T1 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 1, the TE shall switch off and on the UE and skip to step 13.

6.	The SS shall send an *RRCRelease* message to ensure that the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE on Cell 1.

7.	The SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 17.1.1.2.5-1. During time duration T2, Cell 2 shall be powered OFF and the physical cell identity = ((current Cell 2 physical cell identity + 1) mod 1008) shall be changed to ensure Cell 2 is not detected by the UE.

8.	When T2 expires, the SS shall switch the power setting from T2 to T3 as specified in Table 17.1.1.2.5-1.

9.	The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection on the higher priority cell, Cell 2.

10.	If the UE responds on higher priority cell, Cell 2 during time duration T3 within 87 seconds from the beginning of time period T3, then count a success for the event “Re-select higher priority Cell 2”. Otherwise, count a fail for the event “Re-select higher priority Cell 2”.

11.	If the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T3, after the re-selection or when T3 expires, continues with step 12.
Otherwise, if T3 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 2, the TE shall switch off and on the UE and continue with step 13.

12.The SS shall send an *RRCRelease* message to ensure that the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE on Cell 2.

13.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE with generic procedure parameters connectivity *NR* , connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5 on Cell 2.

14.	Repeat steps 2-13 until a test verdict has been achieved.
Each of the events “Re-select lower priority Cell 1” and “Re-select higher priority Cell 2” is evaluated independently for the statistic, resulting in an event verdict: pass or fail. Each event is evaluated only until the confidence level according to Table G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved. Different events may require different times for a verdict.
If both events pass, the test passes. If one event fails, the test fails.

The cell re-selection delay to a higher priority cell is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T3, to the moment when the UE camps on Cell 2 and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the *RRCSetupRequest* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility on Cell 2.

The cell re-selection delay to a higher priority cell shall be less than 87 s.

The cell re-selection delay to a lower priority cell is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T1, to the moment when the UE camps on Cell 1 and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the *RRCSetupRequest* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility on Cell 1.

The cell re-selection delay to a lower priority cell shall be less than 27 s.

The rate of correct cell re-selections observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

NOTE:	The cell re-selection delay to a higher priority cell can be expressed as: Thigher\_priority\_search + Tevaluate, NR\_inter + TSI-NR, and to a lower priority cell can be expressed as: Tevaluate, NR\_inter + TSI-NR,

The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with the confidence level of 95%.

##### 17.1.1.3	NR SA FR2 Cell reselection for UE fulfilling stationary relaxed measurement criterion for 2 Rx UE

Editor’s Note: This test case is complete for the following configurations:

Test frequency f ≤ 40.8 GHz.

UE PC3

This test case is incomplete for Test frequency f &gt; 40.8 GHz

This test case is incomplete for UE power class other than PC3.

###### 17.1.1.3.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify the requirement for the NR SA intra-frequency cell reselection in FR2 for 2 Rx RedCap UEs. The requirements are specified in TS 38.133 [6] in clause 4.2B.2.9.2.

###### 17.1.1.3.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE release 17 and forward supporting Rel-17 relaxed RRM measurements of neighbour cells in RRC\_IDLE/RRC\_INACTIVE.

###### 17.1.1.3.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 17.1.1.0.3.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.17.1.1.3.

###### 17.1.1.3.4	Test description

###### 17.1.1.3.4.2	Test procedure

Two cells are deployed in the test, which are one FR2 NR PCell (Cell 1) and an NR neighbour cell (Cell 2) on the same frequency. The test consists of 2 successive time periods, with time duration of T1 and T2 respectively. Both Cell 1 and Cell 2 are already identified by the UE prior to the start of the test. Cell 1 and Cell 2 belong to different tracking areas.

The UE is configured only low mobility criterion defined in clause 5.2.4.9.1 in TS 38.304 [30]. So, Cell 1 configures the UE as follows:

*-	stationaryMobilityEvaluation-r17* defined in TS 38.331 [13] is configured according to the parameters listed in Table 17.1.1.3.5-1;

*-* cellEdgeEvaluationWhileStationary-r17 defined in TS 38.331 [13] is not configured;

*-* combineRelaxedMeasCondition2-r17 defined in TS 38.331 [13] is not configured.

In the following test procedure “UE responds” means “UE starts transmitting preamble on PRACH for sending the *RRCSETUPREQUEST* message to perform a Registration procedure for mobility.

1.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

2.	Set the parameters according to T1 in Table 17.1.1.3.5-1. T1 starts.

3.	The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection to Cell 2.

4.	If the UE responds on Cell 2 during time duration T1 within 155 seconds from the beginning of time period T1, then count a success for cell reselection. Otherwise, count a fail for cell reselection.

5.	If the UE has re-selected Cell 2 within T1, after the re-selection or when T1 expires, continue with step 6. Otherwise, if T1 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 2, the TE shall switch off and on the UE and skip to step 11.

6	The SS shall send an *RRCRelease* to ensure that the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE.

6.	The SS shall switch the power setting from T1 to T2 as specified in Table 17.1.1.3.5-1. T2 starts.

8.	The SS waits for random access requests information from the UE to perform cell re-selection to an already detected cell, Cell 1.

9.	If the UE responds to Cell 1 during time duration T2 within 155 seconds from the beginning of time period T2, then count a success for cell reselection. Otherwise, count a fail for cell reselection.

10. If T2 expires and the UE has not yet re-selected Cell 1, the TE shall switch off and on the UE and continue with step 11.

11.	Ensure the UE is in state RRC\_IDLE with generic procedure parameters Connectivity *NR* , Connected without release *On* and Test Mode *On* according to TS 38.508-1 [14] clause 4.5.

12.	Repeat steps 2-11 until the confidence level according to Tables G.2.3-1 in Annex G clause G.2 is achieved.

The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell for UE fulfilling stationary relaxed criterion is defined as the time from the beginning of time period T1, to the moment when the UE camps on Cell 2 and starts to send preambles on the PRACH for sending the *RRCSetupRequest* message to perform a registration procedure for mobility on Cell 2.

The cell re-selection delay to an already detected cell shall be less than 155 s.

The rate of correct cell re-selections observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90%.

NOTE:	The cell re-selection delay to an already detectable cell can be expressed as: Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap\_Relax + TSI-NR,

Where:

Tevaluate,NR\_Intra\_RedCap\_Relax	See Table 4.2B.2.9.2-2 in clause 4.2B.2.9.2,

TSI-NR	Maximum repetition period of relevant system info blocks that needs to be received by the UE to camp on a cell; 1280 ms is assumed in this test case.

This gives a total of 154.88 s, allow 155 s for the cell reselection delay to an already detected cell for UE fulfilling stationary criterion in the test case.

The rate of correct events observed during repeated tests shall be at least 90% with the confidence level of 95%.

##### 17.1.1.4	NR SA FR2-FR2 Cell reselection for UE fulfilling stationary mobility relaxed measurement criterion for 2 Rx UE

Editor’s Note: This test case is complete for the following configurations:

Test frequency f ≤ 40.8 GHz.

UE PC3

This test case is incomplete for Test frequency f &gt; 40.8 GHz

This test case is incomplete for UE power class other than PC3.

###### 17.1.1.4.1	Test purpose

The purpose of this test is to verify the requirement for the NR SA inter-frequency cell reselection in FR2 for 2 Rx RedCap UEs. The requirements are specified in TS 38.133 [6] in clause 4.2B.2.10.2.

###### 17.1.1.4.2	Test applicability

This test applies to all types of NR RedCap UE release 17 and forward supporting Rel-17 relaxed RRM measurements of neighbour cells in RRC\_IDLE/RRC\_INACTIVE.

###### 17.1.1.4.3	Minimum conformance requirements

The minimum conformance requirements are defined in clause 17.1.1.0.4.

The normative reference for this requirement is TS 38.133 [6] clause A.17.1.1.4.
